FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At AutoParts Depot, we specialize in the retail of automotive parts and accessories, providing a wide range of products for both consumers and professional mechanics. Our operations are centered around delivering high-quality components while ensuring customer satisfaction through knowledgeable service and support. We maintain a highly organized inventory management system to efficiently handle our stock and offer timely delivery of orders. Our facility adheres strictly to fire safety regulations, including well-maintained fire protection measures. Furthermore, we comply with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations, ensuring our business operations not only meet industry standards but also prioritize the safety of our employees and customers. With a commitment to a strong safety culture, our team is regularly trained in best practices for workplace safety and compliance.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any racing modifications, demolition work, or other high-risk automotive activities, and confirms that it operates within standard business hours, not 24 hours a day. Additionally, we do not operate a self-service automobile repair shop, nor do we participate in salvage, dismantling, or recycling operations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: AutoParts Supply Co. - Retail of automotive supplies and accessories.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred from a slip-and-fall incident on 02/15/2023, resulting in medical expenses totaling $3,000. A theft incident on 07/10/2023, where merchandise valued at $2,000 was stolen, was also reported. Both claims are currently under review with the respective insurance providers.
